description: A stream pass ($0.50 per pass, not per call): up to 60 minutes of Server-Sent Events at /v1/sol/bursts/stream?token=…, pushing Solana pump.fun and Robinhood Chain buyer bursts, pump.fun graduations and new Telegram calls (public chats named, callers hashed) as they fire. The worker appends events every few seconds; heartbeat every 15 s, up to 2 connections per pass. Answers 503 stream_disabled (not charged) when the server has streaming switched off. Costs $0.50 USDC per pass (x402).
name: stream_pass
